coverage: 2000-present: January 2020-present structured Governor archive; 2008-2019 weather emergency orders read from the Secretary of State's order PDFs; 2000-2010 orders from the Secretary of State's executive order compilations (Musgrove and Barbour), most of them National Guard call-outs for storms; plus 18 state of emergency proclamations (2003-2026) added by hand from MEMA's newsroom and dated news coverage, since Mississippi declares states of emergency by proclamation and no index of proclamations is published. No state declaration was found for DR-1443 (November 2002 tornadoes), DR-4470 (October 2019 storm), DR-4478 (January 2020 storms), DR-4727 (June 2023 storms), DR-4790 (April 2024 storms) or DR-4922 (May 2026 storms). DR-1470 (May 2003) counts as matched only because the April 2003 proclamation falls within three weeks of it, DR-4551 (April 22-23, 2020) only because the Easter 2020 proclamation does, and DR-1753 (March to May 2008 flooding) through the April 2008 tornado proclamation inside its incident period; plus 4 weather declarations from FMCSA's archive of state emergency declarations (2017-present)
